title: openai-compat: add Responses API variants, seed/determinism, metadata passthrough, and streaming/function-calling stability fixes
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Adds OpenAI Responses API compatibility variants to Redwood's openai-compat layer including response/choices mappings, seed/determinism flag passthrough, and transparent metadata propagation. Also addresses streaming stability regressions observed with partial-chunk backpressure and improves function/tool calling structured output mapping to Redwood's tools API. Motivation: customers using OpenAI Responses expect consistent fields (type/role/content/metadata) and deterministic seeds for test suites; existing compatibility adapter did not expose seed or metadata and occasionally produced broken streaming chunks when function-calling payloads included nested metadata. This change: 1) introduces a ResponsesAdapter that normalizes 'response' and 'message' shapes into our internal Chat/Response model and adds a lightweight variant toggle so consumers can opt into 'responses_v1' vs 'chat-completions' mapping; 2) surfaces 'seed' and 'determinism' flags from OpenAI-style payloads into the runtime request context and downstream model shim so we can pass determinism through to compatible backends; 3) allows arbitrary 'metadata' key passthrough from the top-level request into generated outputs/events for observability and downstream routing; 4) fixes streaming backpressure handling by batching partial frames for multi-part function-call content and ensuring event ordering for structured tool outputs; 5) expands tests and docs and adds a small migration note for SDK consumers. Implementation notes: adapter is a thin translator with feature toggle, no changes to existing persisted request schema, unit + integration tests included, and live canary deployed to perf-canary cluster for 24h prior to merge. See commits and CI notes for detail.

review_comments: Alex Chen: This looks great overall. Two asks: (1) can we keep backward compatibility for consumers that rely on 'choices[*].message' exact shape? Suggest adding a compatibility-mode flag defaulting to legacy mapping; (2) add a comment in streamer explaining why we batch partial frames rather than reordering at the consumer side.
Diego Martinez: Found a race in the streamer unit test where delayed function payloads cause duplicate 'function_call' events; please add a regression test and ensure idempotency in the mapper.
Samira Gold: Docs are clear. Recommend a short note in the migration guide about SDKs and the new 'responses_variant' flag to avoid surprise behavior for downstream tool parsers.
author_replies: Priya Kapoor: Thanks Alex — implemented compatibility-mode toggle and defaulted to legacy mapping; added comment in streamer. See commit feat(openai-compat): add legacy mapping toggle and comments.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks Diego — added regression test that simulates delayed chunks and fixed dedupe logic in streamer; see fix(streaming): de-duplicate function_call events.
Priya Kapoor: Added migration snippet and SDK helper; expanded docs to mention 'responses_variant' and sample requests.
ci_checks: ci/compat-unit: failed on first run due to missing test fixture; reran and passed
ci/integration: ran perf canary against staged cluster; smoke passed, 24h canary completed with no regressions
merge_summary: Squashed 5 commits into 'main' after canary. No post-merge hotfix required. Observability: new metadata fields are available under request.context.deterministic_seed and events now include 'metadata' passthrough for routing; updated dashboards to surface responses_variant usage.
release_notes: Added OpenAI Responses compatibility variant (responses_v1) and a legacy mapping toggle; seed/determinism flags are now passed through to routing and logs; metadata passthrough enables downstream routing and richer telemetry; streaming improvements reduce out-of-order frames for function outputs. See docs/openai_compat.md for migration steps.
backport_plan: No immediate backport to release branches; if customers on pinned releases need seed passthrough we will patch release-2026-02 on request (low risk change).
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: slight behavioral differences for consumers that parse raw OpenAI payloads; Mitigation: default legacy mapping toggle to preserve previous behavior and document new fields; 24h canary and integration tests validated streaming stability.
notes_for_release_engineering: Update SDK releases with new helper and Typed hints; notify enterprise customers with Dedicated/Private deployments about the new request.context.deterministic_seed field; add migration blurb to release email.
